name: top30-wensity
description: Dashboards and websites on Wensity UI (React + Tailwind v4). wensity-dashboard-kit turns a CSV/JSON sample into a dashboard plan (columns, chart config with CSS-safe keys, KPIs, filters) built from Wensity's free primitives; wensity-brand-preset keeps one theme per project and checks tokens, dark mode and the MCP pin; wensity-landing-composer lays out a landing page from Wensity blocks with free fallbacks. Agents: wensity-ui-scout (read-only plan), wensity-dashboard-builder (installs only after approval) and wensity-ui-qa (checks before merge).
